bio.text: Ryan Gonzalez is a Republican who represents District 50 (Weld County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where he took office on January 8, 2025; Ballotpedia lists him as running for re-election in 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, Gonzalez was born in Sylmar, California, earned bachelor's and graduate degrees from the University of Northern Colorado in 2018, and has worked at Wells Fargo.
